newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were barely changed in moderate trade focused on swaps, dealers said on Thursday.
"There were no major changes in the rates. The market is very liquid," one dealer said.
The spot riyal was quoted at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
One-month rates were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, six months 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and one-year were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
